bearingSource: OSM way 1171542832 long axis 53.2°; +X points to the semicircular apse (NE), the entrance front with porch and towers faces SW (photo 01, camera looking NE along the axis).
approximations: Only the entrance front is documented by a full photograph (01) and a wall/tower corner by photo 02. Plan from the OSM outline (29.4 × 10.9 m, full-width semicircular apse). Side elevations, window counts, the apse and the central drum are inferred from the typology; heights estimated from photo 01 (gable apex ≈ 12.3 m, tower crosses ≈ 18.7 m, dome cross ≈ 17.5 m); roof pitch ≈ 28° estimated.

note.ro: Machetă orientativă, interpretată după fotografii publice de referință, dintre care doar fațada de intrare este fotografiată complet. Acoperișurile, coifurile turnurilor și cupola sunt redate în titan-zinc prepatinat gri închis (elZinc Slate), așa cum apar în fotografiile din 2026 — material livrat de COLOR METAL conform evidențelor sale. Fațadele laterale, absida și înălțimile sunt estimate.
note.hu: Tájékoztató jellegű makett nyilvános referenciafotók alapján; ezek közül csak a bejárati homlokzat látszik teljes egészében. A tetők, a toronysisakok és a kupola sötétszürke, előpatinázott titáncinkként (elZinc Slate) jelennek meg, ahogy a 2026-os fotókon — a COLOR METAL nyilvántartása szerint általa szállított anyag. Az oldalhomlokzatok, az apszis és a magasságok becsültek.
note.en: Indicative scale model interpreted from public reference photographs, of which only the entrance front is fully photographed. The roofs, tower roofs and the dome are shown in dark grey pre-weathered titanium-zinc (elZinc Slate) as photographed in 2026 — the material supplied by COLOR METAL according to its records. The side elevations, the apse and the heights are estimated.
